analog_and_protection.positive_phase_window: Gain10 candidate. Phase shunt 0.5mOhm; use internal DAC3 to G431 COMP1/2/3: DAC3_CH1 feeds COMP1/COMP3 INM and DAC3_CH2 feeds COMP2 INM per RM0440 Table 73. Program both channels to code2979 (DAC output=VREF*DOR/4096), normal internal-only mode with output buffer disabled; DAC3 is internal so PA4/PA5 remain SPI1. Threshold ratio is 0.7272727*VREF_CORE (about2.4V at3.3V) for nominal about+150.015A. DAC3 15MSPS TUE ±5LSB and COMP offset still apply. External TLV1704 negative window about0.89918V for nominal -150.16A. Software phase command <=100A and ramp<=5000A/s candidate, preserve PWM ripple margin; ±120A peak signal about1.05–2.25V. Error/temperature/sampling window and response time remain unqualified.
analog_and_protection.negative_phase_window: VNEG_REF=VREF_CORE*10k/(26.7k+10k)=0.89918V nominal at VREF_CORE=3.3V, giving about-150.16A; tracks CSA VREF/2. Each CSA raw SOx reaches the TLV1704 input through its 1k injection-limiting resistor and is compared against this reference; open-drain outputs share BREAK_N.
analog_and_protection.bus_overvoltage: Current source: U7 TLV6700DDCR B channel uses internal 400mV reference; R_OVTOP=1MΩ to VBUS_OV_SENSE, R_OVBOT=10kΩ to GND_SYS, C_OV_SENSE=1nF, U7 OUTB=BUSOV_N. Threshold screen 39.209–41.724V rising and 38.318–41.311V falling is an independent-corner screen, not a full guarantee. U3 unused channel pins10=GND_SYS, pin11=DUMP_5V, pin13=NC. BUSOV_N drives the Q7 dump driver and Q_BOV_PNP/BC847C BREAK_N path. Low-current full-temperature drive, U7 input current at 0.4V, startup, DUMP_5V high-BUS behavior and physical thresholds remain OPEN.
analog_and_protection.tim1_break_and_arm: AOE=0, MOE reset/cleared by Break, no automatic re-arm. Firmware must configure/read back COMP-to-BKIN routing and polarity before ARM; fault recovery requires DISARM, fault removal, zero/offset checks and explicit new ARM. INH/INL six-PWM both low in 6x mode is the intended all-gates-off state; verify actual DRV truth table/configuration.
analog_and_protection.safe_rail: U2 TPS7A4001 generates SAFE_5V for SAFE_ADC and the FOC-A single LOAD_EN_BIAS_EXT resistor; U6 TPS7A4001 independently generates DUMP_5V from BUS for U3 TLV1704, U4 UCC27511A, U7 TLV6700, the BOV pullups, Q_BOV_PNP and J_TEMP. DUMP_5V is independent of SAFE_5V, but shares BUS and GND_SYS.
analog_and_protection.bus_monitor: BUS_ADC at PC4/P2-12: BUS+ divider 180k/10k; 42V about 2.21V, 60V about 3.158V. R_BUSADC_SER=1k and BZT52H-C3V6 candidate to GND_SYS; software monitor only, not fast BUSOV. PB2/P2-7 remains USB VBUS detect through SB4.
analog_and_protection.dump_thermal_status: J_TEMP normally-closed contact gates U4.IN+ from DUMP_5V; R_DUMP_INP_PD pulls DUMP_THERM_OK low on open contact, open connector or DUMP_5V loss. PB9/P1-24 observes the state in firmware. The contact is only a low-current dump-enable path and is not a hard BREAK_N trip; opening it disables the energy dump, so loss-of-sink behavior remains an explicit system risk.

CSA.VREF: VREF_CORE=coreboard VREF+ (P2-8), filtered at U1 pin26; CSA bidirectional zero-current SO=VREF/2. Do not enable VREFBUF; validate coreboard analog reference source and noise.
CSA.hard_window_candidate_A: Nominal approximately +150.015A/-150.16A with GAIN10; DAC3 code2979 uses RM0440 DOR/4096 and DAC3 internal TUE ±5LSB. Cold electrical corner estimate minimum +131.51A/-130.62A before unbounded CSA drift/response effects. Software phase command <=100A and ramp<=5000A/s candidate candidate, retain ripple margin; not a hardware qualification.
CSA.SEN_OCP: Configure SEN_LVL=00b (minimum 0.25V) and OCP_MODE=00b latched shutdown with nFAULT to BREAK_N. Across 0.5mOhm this is about500A; it is a separate gross fault backup, not a 120A phase-current clamp.
CSA.bus_current_limit: No independent bus-current shunt/comparator in this candidate. 100A BUS is a system/operating target, not locally hard-limited.
CSA.SO_at_plus_minus_120A: For VREF_CORE=3.3V, gain10, 0.5mOhm: nominal CSA_SO about1.05V to2.25V at +/-120A.
CSA.shunt_pulse_screen: At120A each low-side shunt dissipates7.2W instantaneous; KOA explicit short-overload15W/5s supports only a candidate 1s pulse at this point. With terminal60C and Rth8C/W, simple steady bound is +57.6C ->117.6C below130C rating; not continuous-current or PCB thermal PASS. Verify actual terminal temperature, pulse sequence and Kelvin pads.

analog_and_protection.four_quadrant_operation: Six-switch three-phase inverter can drive/brake in both rotation directions; all three low-side shunt CSAs are bidirectional and referenced to VREF/2. Regeneration energy reaches the shared BUS. Local BUSOV hardware should stop the bridge and enable the local dump; another board/battery/source must absorb energy or the local resistor carries it. Gate-off does not isolate body-diode paths.

register_settings.OCP_MODE_register_0x05_bits_7_6: 00b, latched shutdown for VDS_OCP and SEN_OCP
register_settings.OCP_DEG_register_0x05_bits_5_4: 01b, 2us programmed deglitch; 1us exists but 2us is the initial switching-noise compromise pending test
register_settings.VDS_LVL_register_0x05_bits_3_0: 1100b, nominal 0.9V; nearest supported setting to ~0.94V (there is no 0.94V code)
register_settings.OCP_ACT_register_0x02_bit_10: 1, linked response so a half-bridge OCP disables all three half-bridges

VDS_OCP.datasheet_threshold: TI DRV835x Rev A electrical table specifies VDS_LVL=1100b as 0.81V min / 0.90V typ / 0.99V max over the stated temperature range; OCP_DEG codes 00/01/10/11 select 1/2/4/8us. The 0.2V setting (0101b) is rejected.

screening_current_estimates_A.cold_assumption: Use IPT015N10N5 RDS(on) max 2mOhm at VGS=6V and 25C as a conservative cold screening resistance; at 0.9V nominal the crossing is 450A, and 0.81..0.99V corresponds to 405..495A.
screening_current_estimates_A.hot_assumption: Use 5mOhm hot screening resistance (2mOhm x 2.5 design multiplier, not a guaranteed datasheet max); at 0.9V nominal the crossing is 180A, and 0.81..0.99V corresponds to 162..198A.
screening_current_estimates_A.phase_points: At 120A, estimated MOS VDS is 0.24V cold / 0.60V hot; at 150A it is 0.30V cold / 0.75V hot. Hot 150A has only 60mV below the 0.81V minimum trip threshold.
screening_current_estimates_A.rejected_0p2V: At 0.2V nominal (0.18..0.22V), screening crossing is 90..110A cold or 36..44A hot; under the selected hot model it would nuisance-trip well below the intended 120A operating peak.

VDS_OCP.limits: This VDS monitor is a gross MOS overcurrent/short-circuit protection layer, not an accurate phase-current limiter. Actual threshold current changes with MOS RDS(on), junction temperature, gate voltage, parasitic inductance, switching state and reverse current; 5mOhm is a screening assumption only. SEN_OCP is a separate SP voltage threshold and minimum 0.25V across 0.5mOhm is about 500A. Verify short-circuit SOA, parasitic overshoot, false trips, actual fault-to-gate-off time, polarity coverage, and latch/recovery on hardware; do not claim the VDS setting guarantees ±120A protection.

CAN_and_hall_nets.hall_logic: Each Hall channel: J_HALL raw input -> optional 1k series/direct route and/or 10k/18k 5V divider branch -> JP_HA/JP_HB/JP_HC selector -> final MCU/filter net HALL_A/HALL_B/HALL_C. The matching 1nF filter capacitor and coreboard header pin share that final HALL_x net (P1-15, P1-18, P2-5). Open-collector mode requires the selected 4.7k pull-up to MCU_3V3; 3.3V push-pull uses direct; 5V push-pull uses divider; never populate direct and divider together. Output type, edge timing, VDD-off injection and VIH/VIL remain to be verified. TIM2 AF1 Hall candidate: PA15/P1-15, PB3/P1-18, PB10/P2-5; PA15/PB3 require JTAG/SWO release while preserving PA13/PA14 SWD. TIM4 PB6/PB7/PB9 is not the standard Hall CH1-3/XOR map.
CAN_and_hall_nets.termination: 120ohm only at physical end of CAN bus; DNP/jumper otherwise. CAN ESD array placed at connector with short return. USB D+/D- on PA11/PA12 conflict.
CAN_and_hall_nets.ESD: PESD2CANFD24V-T is ESD/transient shunt only. Its clamp must be checked against TCAN1042 common-mode and transient ratings; it does not establish sustained 37.8V miswire tolerance or thermal safety.
CAN_and_hall_nets.TCAN1042: 5V VCC on 5V_BUCK; 3V3 VIO on MCU_3V3; pin8 STB on PB5/P1-20 with 10k pull-up so reset defaults to standby. Exact pin order 1 TXD, 2 GND, 3 VCC, 4 RXD, 5 VIO, 6 CANL, 7 CANH, 8 STB. PA11/PA12 are shared with USB D-/D+ and cannot run both functions simultaneously.

No external 12V is required for this base topology. Gate-charge linear-regulator dissipation with chosen MOSFET Qg and PWM frequency must be calculated and thermally measured; separate 12V only if validation fails.

bulk_capacitor_candidate.rating: 100V, 10000uF, +/-20%, +85C, 50x95mm can, M5 screw terminals and threaded mounting stud (MB2)
bulk_capacitor_candidate.ripple_current: datasheet row: 15.3A at 100Hz/85C; 25.6A at 10kHz/40C; 34.7A at 10kHz/50C only with 2m/s forced air and stud-mounted to 3C/W aluminum chassis. external_energy_dump_candidate.onboard_switch: Q7 IRLB4030PBF low-side N-MOS, U4 UCC27511A powered by DUMP_5V; 10k gate-source pulldown; 5V gate drive is within the MOSFET 4.5V RDS(on) specification. Full gate waveform and thermal qualification remain open.

dump_on_off_threshold_V.assumptions: Current P1 uses BUS-fed U6 DUMP_5V, 162k/10k BUS divider, 10.2k/10k reference divider, 200k positive feedback and 4.7k DUMP_5V pullup. Existing turn_on/turn_off fields are legacy nominal estimates; ranges are independent component corners, not a paired hysteresis guarantee. TI Rev.B Table 6.5 line-regulation unit is %VOUT: over VIN=7–100V the typical value is 0.03% VOUT with MIN/MAX blank, not 0.03%/V; overall accuracy ±2.5% is only specified to VIN=24V. Therefore DUMP_5V 4.7771–5.1983V and BOV threshold corners are assumption-only extrapolated screens at high BUS, not guarantees. Any earlier per-volt multiplication of 0.03% is a user-defined assumption, not a datasheet limit.
dump_on_off_threshold_V.status: screen only; independent resistor/reference/output corners are not a paired board guarantee; verify DUMP_5V, thresholds, ripple, transient and thermal behavior on hardware.

external_energy_dump_candidate.resistor_bank: Current screen at 45.5898V: 2 x Vishay LPS0300H2R00FB 2ohm ±1% parallel = 0.99–1.01ohm per board. At Rbank,min 0.99ohm, about 2.099kW per board and 2.099kJ/board for 1s; each 2ohm branch sees about 1.050kW/1.050kJ. At Rbank,max 1.01ohm, two boards together absorb about 4.116kW, 14.3% above the 3.6kW two-board paper screen. The 1s power is ~3.5x each 300W nameplate; hot-start, repeat interval, heatsink, thermal switch and exact pulse curve still require qualification.
external_energy_dump_candidate.branch_fuse_connector: Eaton CBBF-60 candidate 60A/58VDC is off-board in series from the board BUS+ copper/input terminal to the external Anderson SB50 cable pair; verify exact interrupt rating and fuse curve against battery prospective short current. The SB50 pair routes outbound DUMP_RES_UP to the two external resistors and returns DUMP_SW to board J_DUMP_SW, a four-leg MFE04542-T1 terminal on Q7.D; >=6AWG candidate. Tap branch supply from the existing post-F_MAIN BUS+ copper/terminal, so no additional BUS terminal is needed. Thermostat is a low-current input only; never place it in high-current dump path.
external_energy_dump_candidate.failure_policy: Local BUSOV comparator requests hardware BREAK and turns on the local chopper when DUMP_5V and thermal contact are healthy. SAFE_5V loss does not itself remove the BOV supply path; DUMP_5V/U3/U4/Q7 failure, resistor/fuse open, thermal contact open, or absent BUS can. CAN/soft stop is not a fast substitute. If Q7 D-S shorts, 22.5–45.6V into the ~0.99ohm bank is about 22.7–46.1A, below the nominal 60A branch-fuse rating; the thermostat only interrupts the gate and cannot stop a D-S short. Vehicle requires physical source isolation or an independent high-current thermal disconnect and residual-energy procedure.

unresolved_before_layout_freeze: Configure and read back DRV8353 six-PWM mode, GCSA=10, bidirectional CSA zero=VREF/2, VDS/SEN hard protection, nFAULT latch and ENABLE state; verify DRV package pin map and TI layout.

Validate positive G431 COMP/DAC and negative TLV1704 threshold accuracy and timing at the nominal +150A/-150.16A window; corner estimate is documented separately. CSA drift, analog source/noise, comparator propagation, PWM ripple, temperature and bench response remain unclosed; do not claim a +/-120A independent hard-limit pass.
Validate TIM1 Break sources and polarity, AOE=0, reset MOE=0, six-PWM all-low output truth table, deadtime, low-side shunt sample windows, default DRV_ENABLE low and explicit re-arm.

On the physical Normal QFN48 V10 module verify P1/P2 orientation/continuity, fitted LDO marking, 5V input route, VREF+ path, USB VBUS backfeed and PA11/PA12 USB/CAN exclusivity. Keep PB2 reserved for SB4 USB VBUS detect.
Measure DRV8353R 5V buck startup and thermal margin at22.5/37.8V with actual WeAct/MCU, TCAN1042, Hall and margins. 240mA normal estimate/270mA dominant estimate remain unmeasured against350mA limit.
Measure independent TPS7A4001 SAFE_5V load/startup and thermal loss; at37.8V/50mA linear dissipation would be about1.64W. SAFE_5V loss leaves no local dump path.

Measure IPT VGS and transition times, gate ringing/overshoot, thermal transients, Qg/DRV gate-rail dissipation, PCB/TOLL copper and one-second response. Screening values are not board-level1.8kW/1s PASS.
For each PSF4 shunt preserve exact C4135357 mapping 1/2 high-side and3/4 low-side; measure pin temperature/current sharing, terminal temp and pulse repeat. KOA 15W/5s is not a 120A continuous rating.

Measure BUS ripple spectrum/current and capacitor can temperature against PEH200 datasheet frequency/temperature/cooling conditions; do not apply the10kHz/40C rating at85C or 100Hz without correction.
Check SMCJ40A dynamic clamp under source impedance/layout inductance against MOS/DRV and100V electrolytic limits; it is a transient TVS, not the current U7 threshold screen (~39.209–41.724V).

Test external LPS0300 resistor pair hot/cold pulse, recovery interval, mounting/airflow, enclosure, J_TEMP trip point/contact life, cable and CBBF-60 fuse curve; 1.522–1.758kJ/board at the current threshold screen is an unqualified paper estimate; 1.8kW/1s is a target, not a confirmed hard user limit.

failure_policy.Q7_Drain_Source_Short: Q7 D-S short can continuously draw about22.5-37.8A through 1ohm external bank at normal BUS; F_BRAKE 60A may not open. Vehicle/system requires physical source isolation or independent high-current thermal disconnect plus residual-energy procedure; remains open TODO.
failure_policy.GateOff: PWM/gate-off is not isolation: body diodes can still return regenerative energy to shared BUS; residual voltage and source coupling remain.
failure_policy.CAN: CAN is coordination only and cannot supply fast local protection.
failure_policy.SourcePrecharge: Requires validated source-side precharge for shared 60mF; no board-local contactor included.
failure_policy.SafeRailLoss: SAFE_5V loss degrades SAFE_ADC and the FOC-A shared bias but the current P1 BOV/dump path is powered separately from DUMP_5V. DUMP_5V/U3/U4/Q7 loss or thermal contact open still disables the dump; energy absorption is not guaranteed.

Keep DRV8353 VM/VDRAIN, charge-pump capacitors, VREF capacitor, gate loops and each half-bridge ceramic loop short per TI layout guidance.
Place the 3 x 4.7uF + 3 x 100nF local BUS ceramics tightly at the three half bridges; validate effective MLCC capacitance under DC bias.
Hall divider/selector options are mutually exclusive per channel; never populate both direct and 5V divider straps. Hall sensor output type and MCU VDD-off injection are unresolved.
Do not connect PA11/PA12 to a USB host and CAN simultaneously; verify USB VBUS isolation/backfeed with board supplied from 5V_BUCK.
Q7 external dump bank and its fuse/connector need enclosure, cable, thermal, short-circuit and source-isolation validation before use.

drv8353rs_notes.VREF: Use WeAct Normal P2-8 VREF+ as shared VREF_CORE; bypass pin26 with100nF and do not enable MCU VREFBUF.

drv8353rs_notes.Fault: Configure SPI OCP_MODE=00b latched shutdown, OCP_DEG=01b (2us pending bench), VDS_LVL=1100b (0.9V nominal, 0.81..0.99V datasheet limits), OCP_ACT=1 linked shutdown, SEN_LVL=00b minimum 0.25V; nFAULT is wired to BREAK_N. VDS protects gross MOS overcurrent/shorts, not precision phase current. Estimated hot crossing 162..198A using 5mOhm screening RDS; cold crossing 405..495A using 2mOhm. 0.2V setting is rejected because the hot screening crossing would be only36..44A. Verify SOA, parasitics, nuisance trips and total response on hardware; no ±120A guarantee.

VDS_SEN_SPI_initial_candidate.datasheet_threshold: TI DRV835x Rev A electrical table specifies VDS_LVL=1100b as 0.81V min / 0.90V typ / 0.99V max over the stated temperature range; OCP_DEG codes 00/01/10/11 select 1/2/4/8us. The 0.2V setting (0101b) is rejected.

screening_current_estimates_A.cold_assumption: Use IPT015N10N5 RDS(on) max 2mOhm at VGS=6V and 25C as a conservative cold screening resistance; at 0.9V nominal the crossing is 450A, and 0.81..0.99V corresponds to 405..495A.
screening_current_estimates_A.hot_assumption: Use 5mOhm hot screening resistance (2mOhm x 2.5 design multiplier, not a guaranteed datasheet max); at 0.9V nominal the crossing is 180A, and 0.81..0.99V corresponds to 162..198A.
screening_current_estimates_A.phase_points: At 120A, estimated MOS VDS is 0.24V cold / 0.60V hot; at 150A it is 0.30V cold / 0.75V hot. Hot 150A has only 60mV below the 0.81V minimum trip threshold.
screening_current_estimates_A.rejected_0p2V: At 0.2V nominal (0.18..0.22V), screening crossing is 90..110A cold or 36..44A hot; under the selected hot model it would nuisance-trip well below the intended 120A operating peak.

VDS_SEN_SPI_initial_candidate.limits: This VDS monitor is a gross MOS overcurrent/short-circuit protection layer, not an accurate phase-current limiter. Actual threshold current changes with MOS RDS(on), junction temperature, gate voltage, parasitic inductance, switching state and reverse current; 5mOhm is a screening assumption only. SEN_OCP is a separate SP voltage threshold and minimum 0.25V across 0.5mOhm is about 500A. Verify short-circuit SOA, parasitic overshoot, false trips, actual fault-to-gate-off time, polarity coverage, and latch/recovery on hardware; do not claim the VDS setting guarantees ±120A protection.

logic_and_failure_states.normal_bus: U7 OUTB high impedance; R_OV_PU raises BUSOV_N; U4 IN- high, so with DUMP_THERM_OK high output is low and Q7 is off.
logic_and_failure_states.overvoltage_and_thermal_contact_closed: U7 OUTB pulls BUSOV_N low; U4 IN+ high and IN- low, DUMP_DRV_OUT high, Q7 on. Existing Q_BOV_PNP/BC847C path independently asserts BREAK_N.
logic_and_failure_states.thermal_contact_open: U4 IN+ is pulled low; Q7 off even during BOV. Overvoltage still asserts BREAK_N through the separate BOV transistor path.
logic_and_failure_states.U7_unpowered_DUMP5_alive: OUTB goes high impedance; BUSOV_N is pulled high, so local BOV fails open.
logic_and_failure_states.DUMP5_lost: UCC27511A output is held low below its maximum 4.65V rising UVLO; dump path unavailable.
logic_and_failure_states.U7_startup: Output is guaranteed correct only after VDD exceeds 1.8V for up to 450µs; a BUS already above threshold during rail startup is an unresolved detection delay.
logic_and_failure_states.MCU_state: MCU GPIO is monitoring only; MCU high/low does not gate local BOV.
